newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH SEPT TRADE DATA DUE TODAY 1200 -CUSTOMS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH SEPT TRADE DATA DUE TODAY 1200 -CUSTOMS.

text.p: Finnish September trade balance figures will be released today Tuesday at 1200, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement.
In August, the trade surplus was 3.47 billion markka for an eight-month total of 31.87 billion markka, NCB said earlier.
The Bank of Finland's estimate for the September trade surplus was 3.7 billion markka with exports at 15.0 billion markka and imports at 11.3 billion.
